item.title: Mesh Fabrics: Structure, Applications, and Customization Options
item.description:
Mesh Fabrics: Structure, Applications, and Customization Options
#

Mesh fabric stands apart from traditional tightly woven textiles due to its open, loose weave that forms thousands of small holes across the surface. This distinctive structure provides excellent breathability and airflow, making mesh fabrics particularly well-suited for warm and humid environments, such as those found in the Middle East, Southern Europe, and America.

item.title: Tetoron Cotton Blended Fabrics: Properties and Applications
item.description:
Introduction to T/C (Tetoron Cotton) Fabric
#

T/C fabric, also known as Tetoron Cotton, is a blend of polyester and cotton fibers. This material is recognized for its breathability, pleasant hand-feel, and resistance to moisture and mold. The term ‘Tetoron’ originated in Japan over 40 years ago as a name for polyester. Today, T/C fabric typically consists of 65% polyester and 35% cotton, combining the strengths of both fibers.
